scope: Initial private use. This is a feature-regression checkpoint, not a production SLO or deployment capacity claim.

longRunningWork.note: The delivered portable payload remains bounded to 500 people. A future operation above that bound must run as durable background work and must not extend an ordinary request timeout.

directoryLastContacted.query: GET /api/v1/people?sort=last-contacted, through the people-directory repository: six 20-person pages after one warming read, with and without starred-first
directoryLastContacted.rationale: The representative-query and ordinary-API-read ceilings above, which every directory order must meet. last-contacted is the order that reads the interaction history; D6 builds no projection (AUD-Q4) and no trigram index until a measurement at the large profile is above this ceiling.

reminderOccurrences.rationale: D5 keeps every sent occurrence. Measured at the large profile with a weekly reminder for each of 10,000 people (an eight-week pending window plus sent history), the table and its indexes grow by about 600 bytes a row while the in-app feed page, the open-reminder arm, and the worker's due claim stay under 1.2 ms. The ceiling is the measured envelope, about five years of that history; beyond either number the retention decision reopens.

points.note: a fresh database seeded by reproduce.seed

reproduce.database: A migrated v13 database after tests/integration/people_directory_capacity_postgres_test.ts has seeded its large-profile workspace (10,000 people). Run with psql, setting :workspace and :member to that workspace and its owner's membership, then analyze crm.reminders and crm.reminder_occurrences.
seed: insert into crm.reminders (workspace_id, person_id, target_kind, title, anchor_on, recurrence_unit, recurrence_interval, send_time, created_by_member_id) select :'workspace'::uuid, person.id, 'person', 'Weekly ' || person.given_name, current_date - 364, 'week', 1, '09:00', :'member'::uuid from crm.people person where person.workspace_id = :'workspace'::uuid

insert into crm.reminder_occurrences (reminder_id, member_id, occurs_on, deliver_at, status, title_snapshot) select reminder.id, :'member'::uuid, reminder.anchor_on + week * 7, (reminder.anchor_on + week * 7 + time '09:00') at time zone 'UTC', 'pending', reminder.title from crm.reminders reminder cross join generate_series(52, 59) week where reminder.workspace_id = :'workspace'::uuid

insert into crm.reminder_occurrences (reminder_id, member_id, occurs_on, deliver_at, status, sent_at, title_snapshot, provider_receipt, provider_result_state, provider_effect_at, visible_at, attempt_count, last_attempt_at) select reminder.id, :'member'::uuid, reminder.anchor_on + week * 7, at.value, 'sent', at.value, reminder.title, 'in-app:' || gen_random_uuid(), 'confirmed', at.value, at.value, 1, at.value from crm.reminders reminder cross join generate_series(-208, 51) week cross join lateral (select (reminder.anchor_on + week * 7 + time '09:00') at time zone 'UTC' as value) at where reminder.workspace_id = :'workspace'::uuid
reproduce.seedNote: The sent-history insert writes weeks -208 to 51, five years (2,600,000 rows); the 600,000-row point is weeks 0 to 51 only.

queries.feedPage: explain (analyze) select occurrence.id from crm.reminder_occurrences occurrence join crm.reminders reminder on reminder.id = occurrence.reminder_id and reminder.workspace_id = :'workspace'::uuid and reminder.deleted_at is null where occurrence.member_id = :'member'::uuid and occurrence.channel = 'in_app' and occurrence.status = 'sent' and occurrence.visible_at is not null order by date_trunc('milliseconds', occurrence.visible_at at time zone 'UTC') desc, occurrence.id desc limit 51
queries.openArm: explain (analyze) select occurrence.id from crm.reminder_occurrences occurrence where occurrence.member_id = :'member'::uuid and occurrence.status in ('pending', 'retry', 'failed', 'manual_attention') order by (case when occurrence.status = 'retry' then occurrence.next_attempt_at else occurrence.deliver_at end) limit 20
queries.dueClaim: explain (analyze) select id from crm.reminder_occurrences where status in ('pending', 'retry') and coalesce(next_attempt_at, deliver_at) <= now() order by status, coalesce(next_attempt_at, deliver_at) limit 100 for update skip locked

reproduce.queryNote: Each query is the index-bearing core of its production read: the in-app arm of the notifications feed (notifications_repository.ts), the open-reminder order Today and the person page share, and the worker's due claim. Three consecutive runs each; the first is cold.
